name: comp-551
blurb: File uploads displayed in a data table with sortable columns.
description: Multi-file upload manager using table layout. Shows file name, size, upload date, status with sortable columns and bulk actions.
use_when: Enterprise file management, data-heavy upload flows, or large file collections.
avoid_when: Mobile or responsive contexts; tables don't scale well.
a11y: Table follows ARIA table semantics. Sortable headers have buttons with aria-sort.
